info.title: EMI-at-Counter Copilot API
info.description: REST contract for the merchant and customer apps. JSON is camelCase, money is integer paise (never a float) and every error is an RFC 7807 problem with a stable code.

get.summary: List the EMI offers for an item
get.description: Asks the payment gateway for every EMI plan on one item at one price and returns them in the gateway's order; no plan is hidden or ranked. monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted figure; the last installment, extra in total and total payable come from our exact schedule, which adds up to the paisa (ADR 0001). Layer 1 gateway endpoint: unauthenticated (ADR 0009); it reads public offer terms only. Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

post.summary: Create a payment link for the chosen plan
post.description: Re-quotes the chosen offer server-side, freezes its plan and asks the gateway for a payment link exactly once per Idempotency-Key; the call is never retried. The same key and body return the original 201 response. A gateway timeout answers 504 and the key then answers 409 PAYMENT_LINK_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: start again with a new key (ADR 0005). Location points at the payment's status, which answers only for a payment of one of the shop's sales: for a counter sale use POST /api/v1/sales/{saleId}/payment-links. Layer 1 gateway endpoint that needs the merchant bearer token since Layer 2 (plan Q16) and is limited per shop (429 with Retry-After). Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Required. 8 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces (a UUID or ULID is ideal). The same key with the same body returns the original 201 response; with a different body it is refused with 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (ADR 0005).

post.summary: Receive a payment notification from the gateway
post.description: Called by the payment gateway, not by our apps. The body is form-encoded key/value text [Verify] of at most 16 KiB. Its signature (CHECKSUMHASH) is verified over every field before any field is read; a mismatch answers 401 and is audited. A verified notification answers 202 with no body, also when it repeats an earlier one (no extra effect) or names an order that is not ours. Authenticated by the signature only; no credentials (ADR 0009). A generous per-client limit applies (429 with Retry-After).

post.summary: Pair a counter device with the shop id and PIN
post.description: Trades the shop id and the shop's 6-digit pairing PIN for a bearer token for this device. The token is shown once and only its hash is stored; it lasts 12 hours by default. This endpoint needs no credentials and is rate-limited per client address. An unknown shop and a wrong PIN get the same 401; 5 wrong PINs in a row lock the shop for 15 minutes (429 with Retry-After). Location points at the signed-in profile. The answer is never cached (Cache-Control: no-store).

get.summary: Follow the shop's sale statuses live
get.description: Server-Sent Events. `event: sale-status` carries one sale's new status, with exactly saleId, status and statusChangedAt as JSON in data; it is sent only after the change is committed, and only to the shop that owns the sale. `event: resync` (data {}) means messages were dropped because the client fell behind: read GET /api/v1/sales?view=counter again. A `: heartbeat` comment comes every 15 seconds while nothing happens. The stream ends when the device token expires. Send the token in the Authorization header (fetch-based client), never in the URL. Merchant endpoint: send the device's bearer token from POST /api/v1/merchants/pairing. Only the signed-in shop's own data is returned. Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

post.summary: Start a sale and get its customer QR code
post.description: Starts a sale of one catalogue product at its list price (the price at the counter cannot be changed). The sale is CHOOSING and gets a 4-digit session code unique among the shop's open sales, and qr holds the URL to show as a QR code, valid for 15 minutes by default. An optional Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same sale. Location points at the sale; the answer is never cached. Merchant endpoint: send the device's bearer token from POST /api/v1/merchants/pairing. Only the signed-in shop's own data is returned. Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional. 8 to 255 visible ASCII characters (a UUID or ULID is ideal). The same key with the same body returns the original sale, as it now stands, with qr null (raw QR tokens are never kept; ask POST .../qr-tokens for a new one); with a different body it is refused with 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Keys are scoped to the shop.

Show the link on the tablet as a QR code and a copy button: nothing is sent to anyone. Limited per shop (429 with Retry-After). Merchant endpoint: send the device's bearer token from POST /api/v1/merchants/pairing. Only the signed-in shop's own data is returned. Money is integer paise; errors are application/problem+json.

401.description: The bearer token is missing, unknown, expired or revoked; the answer carries WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. Pair the device again.

value.title: Merchant sign-in required
value.detail: A valid merchant bearer token is required; pair the device again.

404.description: The sale is not one of the signed-in shop's sales (another shop's looks the same).

value.title: Sale not found
value.detail: No sale with this id belongs to the shop.

409.description: The customer has not agreed to a plan yet (CHOOSING), or the sale EXPIRED.

SALE_STATE_CONFLICT.summary: Not possible in the sale's current status

value.title: Not possible in the sale's current status
value.detail: A sale that is CHOOSING has no agreed plan to hand off.

422.description: A field, query parameter or header is missing or invalid; fieldErrors names each one.

value.title: Request validation failed
value.detail: One or more request fields are missing or invalid; see fieldErrors.

429.description: The shop made too many payment link or status calls in this minute.

value.title: Too many requests
value.detail: Too many payment requests from this shop; try again after Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before trying again.

500.description: An unexpected failure; the body never holds a stack trace.

value.title: Internal server error
value.detail: An unexpected error occurred; quote the correlation id when reporting it.

502.description: The payment gateway is unavailable, refused the call or answered unusably.

value.title: Payment gateway unavailable
value.detail: The gateway could not serve the call.

value.title: Payment gateway refused the request
value.detail: The gateway refused the request as invalid.

value.title: Unusable payment gateway answer
value.detail: The gateway quoted two plans with the same id.

504.description: The payment gateway did not answer in time.

value.title: Payment gateway timed out
value.detail: The gateway did not answer in time.

CatalogueProductResponse.title: CatalogueProductResponse
CatalogueProductResponse.description: One product at its list price with the counts behind "3 EMI plans, 1 with no extra cost".

ChosenPlanResponse.title: ChosenPlanResponse
ChosenPlanResponse.description:
The plan the customer agreed to, exactly as shown to them (plan Q17, ADR 0001).

monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted monthly figure; the extra and the total
come from the exact schedule on the sale price.

CounterSalesResponse.title: CounterSalesResponse
CounterSalesResponse.description: Today's sales at the counter, newest first; another shop's sales never appear.

CreatePaymentLinkRequest.title: CreatePaymentLinkRequest
CreatePaymentLinkRequest.description: The plan the customer chose for one item; every figure is re-quoted server-side.

customerUrl.title: Customerurl
customerUrl.description: Encode this in the QR code. The token is in the #t= fragment, which a browser never sends to a server; do not log or store it.

expiresAt.title: Expiresat
expiresAt.description: When the QR code stops working, UTC.

CustomerQrResponse.title: CustomerQrResponse
CustomerQrResponse.description: What the QR code encodes and when it stops working; shown once, never stored.

accessToken.title: Accesstoken
accessToken.description: Opaque bearer token; only its hash is stored, so it cannot be shown again.

expiresAt.title: Expiresat
expiresAt.description: When the token stops working, UTC.

DevicePairingResponse.title: DevicePairingResponse
DevicePairingResponse.description: A new device token, shown once: send it as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

EdcEmiProgramme.title: EdcEmiProgramme
EdcEmiProgramme.description: Which EMI menu to choose on the card machine.

isNoExtraCost.title: Isnoextracost
isNoExtraCost.description: True when the customer pays no extra.

amountInPaise.title: Amountinpaise
amountInPaise.description: The item price to check on the machine.

EdcInstructionsResponse.title: EdcInstructionsResponse
EdcInstructionsResponse.description: What to key into the card machine: the EMI menu, product, tenure and amount to check.

EmiOfferResponse.title: EmiOfferResponse
EmiOfferResponse.description:
One EMI plan: the lender's monthly figure beside our exact schedule totals (ADR 0001).

monthlyInstallmentInPaise is the lender's quoted figure. The other amounts come from our
schedule: the remainder sits on the last installment, so the installments add up to
totalPayableInPaise exactly.

EmiType.title: EmiType
EmiType.description: The pricing kind of an EMI plan; stored by value inside frozen offer snapshots.

FieldErrorResponse.title: FieldErrorResponse
FieldErrorResponse.description: One invalid request field, named as on the wire, with an English message.

HandoffPaymentStatus.title: HandoffPaymentStatus
HandoffPaymentStatus.description: Where an agreed sale's payment stands, as M4 shows it; never "declined" (spec 7.5).

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Body returned by GET /health while the process is able to serve requests.

paymentUrl.title: Paymenturl
paymentUrl.description: Show it on the tablet as a QR code with a copy button; it is never sent anywhere by us.

LatestPaymentLinkResponse.title: LatestPaymentLinkResponse
LatestPaymentLinkResponse.description: The sale's newest payment link and where its payment stands.

MerchantProfileResponse.title: MerchantProfileResponse
MerchantProfileResponse.description: The signed-in shop and device, as the merchant app shows them in its header.

OfferSnapshotResponse.title: OfferSnapshotResponse
OfferSnapshotResponse.description:
The exact plan frozen when the link was made: tenure - 1 regular installments, then a last.

The amounts are our schedule's, so they add up to totalPayableInPaise to the paisa.

OffersResponse.title: OffersResponse
OffersResponse.description: Every offer the gateway quotes for the item, in the gateway's order; none is hidden.

shopId.title: Shopid
shopId.description: The shop's id, as printed for the shop.

pin.title: Pin
pin.description: The shop's 6-digit pairing PIN, as text so leading zeros survive.

PairDeviceRequest.title: PairDeviceRequest
PairDeviceRequest.description: The shop id and 6-digit pairing PIN typed on the counter device (M1).

PaymentLinkResponse.title: PaymentLinkResponse
PaymentLinkResponse.description:
The link to hand to the customer, as created; poll the Location URL for later status.

status is always the status the link had when it was created (AWAITING_PAYMENT), so a replay
with the same Idempotency-Key returns exactly the original response (api-conventions.md
section 5). The current status is served by GET /api/v1/payments/{orderId}/status.

PaymentStatusResponse.title: PaymentStatusResponse
PaymentStatusResponse.description:
Where one payment stands, confirmed with the gateway server-side on this request.

amountPaidInPaise is set only when the gateway reports the payment as paid; it can be below
the link amount when a discount applied.

detail.title: Detail
examples: The chosen offer is not quoted for this item and price.

fieldErrors.title: Fielderrors
fieldErrors.description: Set only on request validation problems.

ProblemDetailsResponse.title: ProblemDetailsResponse
ProblemDetailsResponse.description:
An error: a stable code for the UI to translate and an English detail for developers.

It never holds a stack trace, SQL, a vendor payload or personal data.

ProductsResponse.title: ProductsResponse
ProductsResponse.description: The merchant's products, dearest first then by name; another shop's never appear.

PublicPaymentStatus.title: PublicPaymentStatus
PublicPaymentStatus.description:
Where a payment stands, as the UIs see it; decoupled from the stored attempt status.

The stored statuses may be renamed or split later without breaking the wire contract.

sessionCode.title: Sessioncode
sessionCode.description: Four digits to tell sales apart on screen; never a credential.

statusChangedAt.title: Statuschangedat
statusChangedAt.description: When the status last changed, UTC.

SaleDetailResponse.title: SaleDetailResponse
SaleDetailResponse.description: One sale with its product id and start; qr is set only in the answer that issued it.

paymentConfirmedAt.title: Paymentconfirmedat
paymentConfirmedAt.description: When the gateway's confirmed payment moved the sale to PAID, UTC.

SaleHandoffResponse.title: SaleHandoffResponse
SaleHandoffResponse.description: M4: the sale with its agreed plan (monthly, extra and total), EDC steps and latest link.

paymentUrl.title: Paymenturl
paymentUrl.description: Show it on the tablet as a QR code with a copy button; it is never sent anywhere by us.

SalePaymentLinkResponse.title: SalePaymentLinkResponse

paymentConfirmedAt.title: Paymentconfirmedat
paymentConfirmedAt.description: When the gateway's confirmed payment moved the sale to PAID, UTC.

SalePaymentStatusResponse.title: SalePaymentStatusResponse
SalePaymentStatusResponse.description: Where an agreed sale's payment stands; the confirmation time is set only once PAID.

SaleStatus.title: SaleStatus
SaleStatus.description:
The five merchant-visible sale statuses; stored by value, so a rename needs a migration.

None of them reveals a customer's step-by-step progress: CHOOSING covers everything from the
QR scan to the moment the customer agrees to a plan.

SaleStatusEventPayload.title: SaleStatusEventPayload
SaleStatusEventPayload.description: The data of one sale-status event: which sale, its status now and since when.

sessionCode.title: Sessioncode
sessionCode.description: Four digits to tell sales apart on screen; never a credential.

statusChangedAt.title: Statuschangedat
statusChangedAt.description: When the status last changed, UTC.

SaleSummaryResponse.title: SaleSummaryResponse
SaleSummaryResponse.description: One sale on the counter list: code, product, price, status and, once agreed, the plan.

SalesView.title: SalesView
SalesView.description: Which list of sales to read; the counter view is the only one in Layer 2.

StartSaleRequest.title: StartSaleRequest
StartSaleRequest.description: The product the customer wants; the price is always the catalogue list price.

MerchantBearerToken.description: The accessToken from POST /api/v1/merchants/pairing, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It lasts 12 hours by default; pair again after.
